kind: self-service storefront improvement, no pull request needed
mechanism: the catalog reads screenshots.json from the plugin's own repository on its nightly build; declaring it controls which images the market's detail view shows and in what order
whyItMatters: the market detail view is AppStore-style with screenshots; without a declaration the storefront falls back to scraping the README, which we do not control

whatWasMade.source: regenerated from last night's walkthrough screenshots rather than the older storefront captures, so the images show the evidence gate, one-at-a-time review and the approved state as they are today
whatWasMade.declaration: screenshots.json at the repository root, three relative paths

new: the declared shots are the freshly generated ones

whenItTakesEffect: the next nightly catalog build; today's build (04:46Z) may already have run, so the earliest visible effect is the following one
notVerified: how the three images actually look inside the market's detail view — that needs the next build plus the UI
